userStories.title: Project import and transcription
userStories.description: Import a user-provided video into public/video.mp4, inspect media metadata with ffprobe, and create word-level subtitles from the voiceover.
acceptanceCriteria: public/video.mp4 exists after import
data/transcript.json exists with word-level timestamps
Composition duration and fps are derived from the source video/storyboard
No final render is started during preparation

userStories.title: Mechanical storyboard scaffold
userStories.description: Generate a minimal storyboard scaffold that only includes safe factual hints: subtitles, year/date stamps, and person labels.
acceptanceCriteria: data/storyboard.json exists
Generated overlays are limited to year_stamp and person_label
No opening title, chapter title, section title, abstract card, quote card, or outro text is generated
The storyboard is treated as a scaffold for the AI director pass

userStories.title: Video-specific Remotion animation
userStories.description: Use the transcript and sampled frames to design custom animation for this video rather than reusing a fixed animation menu.
acceptanceCriteria: Custom animation is only added where it clarifies this video
50/50 split scenes are not used in the first 5-10 seconds
Each split scene uses one half for source video and the other half as a full-height Remotion canvas
Custom split overlay types are registered in CUSTOM_SPLIT_OVERLAY_TYPES and rendered in MainComposition.tsx

userStories.title: Subtitles and factual labels
userStories.description: Keep readable subtitles throughout the video and use compact year/name labels only when they genuinely help.
acceptanceCriteria: Subtitles remain visible and synced
Year/date cards are factual and restrained
Person labels or cutouts are used only when they fit the story
Labels do not cover key action or collide with subtitles

userStories.title: Review-first validation
userStories.description: Validate the edit with still frames before any final render.
acceptanceCriteria: Opening frame is checked
At least two overlay or animation moments are checked
One late-video frame is checked
Problems found in review frames are fixed before handoff

userStories.title: Versioned render safety
userStories.description: Render only after explicit user approval and always export to the next safe versioned filename.
acceptanceCriteria: Render requires explicit user request
Approved render writes to out/final-N.mp4
out/final.mp4 is never targeted or overwritten
Rendered output is verified after export
